goal: feat(home): accessible reviews carousel with a big five-star hero
summary: The home reviews band's verbatim Google quotes now run as an accessible client-only carousel and the aggregate leads the band as proof. A new components/review-carousel.tsx renders a scroll-snapped horizontal track of the six reviews whose full text has been read at the source: one card at a time, prev/next arrows, a dot rail that doubles as the position readout, arrow-key support on the focused track, aria-roledescription carousel/slide semantics and an aria-live polite region for the active slide. There is no autoplay, smooth-scrolling is skipped under prefers-reduced-motion, and dot controls are 24px targets with the marker drawn inside (WCAG 2.5.8). components/client-reviews.tsx now leads the band with the rating figure and an oversized star row that scale together on one fluid clamp() curve (em-rating, em-stars) instead of the fixed 48px text-5xl leading-none step the display-type guard exists to catch. The rating stays attributed prose next to a link to the profile, never aggregateRating JSON-LD. Data provenance is unchanged: data/google-reviews.json holds the reviewed snapshot and scripts/sync-google-reviews.mjs can only update counts, sampled names and the read date, never authoring quote text, and leaving the file untouched when the Places API is unavailable.
risk: Presentational change to one home section plus one new client component, one stylesheet slice, one data file and a sync script. Touches 8 paths (1 new component, 1 component, 1 stylesheet, 1 test file, 1 data file, 1 lib file, 1 script, check payload). No routing, pricing, offer, or customer-data change; merge remains gated on all GitHub checks being green. The carousel is the only client-side JavaScript added and it is inert without the quotes it is handed.
requested_actions: merge only after all GitHub checks are green
public_claims: The home reviews band renders the verbatim Google reviews the operator asked to surface in an accessible, non-autoplaying carousel with keyboard support and a screen-reader announcement of the active slide.
The reviews band leads with the 5.0 aggregate and a five-star row sized fluidly, attributed prose next to a source link, with no aggregateRating JSON-LD.

evidence.reviewer_ensemble: Builder, skeptic and taste review. Builder: implemented the carousel component and the fluid five-star hero. Skeptic: verified the rating is still attributed prose with no aggregateRating JSON-LD, the carousel has no autoplay, and the sync script still cannot author quote text. Taste: the five stars now read as the proof the operator asked for and the band reads as a deliberate section rather than a line of prose.
evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: No blocking disagreement between builder, skeptic and taste on scope. The band still shows the six reviews whose full text is verifiable at the source rather than all eleven, because the Places feed returns a rotating five-name sample and cannot be trusted to reproduce quote text; that limit is stated in the band copy rather than papered over.
evidence.winner_rationale: Chose a native scroll-snapped scroller with lightweight arrows, dots and an active-index readout over a JS-driven slider, because the platform already does momentum and snapping and the extra JavaScript would re-implement them worse. No autoplay was considered and rejected: moving social proof steals reading time from a visitor mid-sentence.
